subject: design-technology
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: Which component allows current to flow in one direction only?
questions.explain: A diode conducts current in one direction and blocks it in the reverse direction.

questions.q: What is the main function of a resistor in a circuit?
options: To limit or control the current
questions.explain: A resistor opposes current flow, limiting the current in a circuit.

questions.q: What does the abbreviation LED stand for?
questions.explain: An LED is a Light Emitting Diode that gives out light when current flows through it.

questions.q: Why is a resistor usually connected in series with an LED?
options: To limit the current and prevent the LED being damaged
To store charge for the LED
To reverse the current through the LED
questions.explain: Without a series (current-limiting) resistor the excess current would damage the LED.

questions.q: Which component is used to store electrical charge?
questions.explain: A capacitor stores electrical charge and releases it when needed.

questions.q: Which of the following is an input component?
questions.explain: An LDR senses light and provides an input signal; a buzzer, motor and lamp are outputs.

questions.q: How does the resistance of an LDR change as the light intensity falling on it increases?
questions.explain: An LDR's resistance falls as light intensity rises, allowing more current to flow.

questions.q: How does the resistance of an NTC thermistor change as its temperature rises?
options: The resistance drops to zero instantly
questions.explain: A negative temperature coefficient (NTC) thermistor's resistance decreases as temperature increases.

questions.q: Which of the following is an output component?
questions.explain: A buzzer produces sound as an output; switches, LDRs and thermistors are inputs.

questions.q: In an input-process-output system, which stage does a transistor used as a switch usually perform?
questions.explain: A transistor processes the input signal, switching the output on or off.

questions.q: Which equation correctly states Ohm's law?
questions.explain: Ohm's law states that voltage equals current multiplied by resistance.

questions.q: A current of 2 A flows through a resistor with 6 V across it. What is its resistance?
questions.explain: Using R = V / I gives 6 / 2 = 3 ohm.

questions.q: A 12 V supply is connected across a 4 ohm resistor. What current flows?
questions.explain: Using I = V / R gives 12 / 4 = 3 A.

questions.q: What is the role of a switch in a circuit?
options: To open or close the circuit, controlling current flow
questions.explain: A switch makes or breaks the circuit, turning the current on or off.

questions.q: Which statement best describes a microcontroller?
options: A programmable integrated circuit that controls outputs based on inputs
A component that only stores electrical charge
questions.explain: A microcontroller is a programmable IC that responds to inputs to control outputs.

questions.q: What is a key advantage of using a microcontroller instead of fixed circuitry?
options: Its behaviour can be changed by reprogramming without rewiring
It never needs a power supply
It cannot be reprogrammed once built
It removes the need for any input devices
questions.explain: A microcontroller can be reprogrammed to change how it works without altering the hardware.

questions.q: Programs for a microcontroller are commonly planned using which of the following?
questions.explain: Flowcharts are used to plan the sequence of instructions for a microcontroller program.

questions.q: In a flowchart, which symbol is used to represent a decision?
questions.explain: A diamond represents a decision with yes/no branches in a flowchart.

questions.q: A designer wants a lamp to switch on automatically when it gets dark. Which input sensor is most suitable?
questions.explain: An LDR senses light levels, so it can detect darkness to trigger the lamp.

questions.q: A microcontroller reads a temperature sensor and turns on a fan when it is too hot. In this system the fan is the:
questions.explain: The fan is the actuator driven by the microcontroller, making it the output of the system.
